attempts.text:
**The window starts in the `rha` cluster.** Columns 0 to 9 are spine, carried by 92 to 100% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 9% of calls. The model names 11 to 100% of genes there, fewest at column 4 (`rhaR`), 11%, and hesitates most at column 1 (`kdgT`), 0.66 bits.

**Then a fork and variable stretch**, columns 10 to 14, in a region of plasticity in 70 to 80% of calls. The `frv` genes, [[sugar transport and rhamnose catabolism]], are the most carried: `frvA` in 78%, `frvB` in 79%, `frvX` in 79%, `frvR` in 75%, `yiiG` in 69%. The model names 81 to 98% of genes, fewest and most hesitant at column 10, 81% and 0.75 bits.

**A spine follows**, columns 15 to 19, 98% carried, then columns 21 to 25, 97 to 98%, both in a region of plasticity in 3 to 31% of calls. The model names 90 to 99% of genes there. Column 20 is a fork, `yiiF` in 83%, named 95%.

**The widest opening is columns 26 to 38**, fork and variable, in a region of plasticity in 55 to 89% of calls. The `yih` genes run from `csqR` to `yihP`, [[sugar acid catabolism]], with a second branch of 8 families, 16 to 18% carried, from an aldose 1-epimerase to a DeoR/GlpR family regulator. Then `yihO` to `yihL`, 67 to 87% carried. The model names 82 to 96% of genes, fewest at column 33, 82%, and hesitates most at column 35 (`ompL`), 0.59 bits.

**The long spine runs from `typA` to `rmuC`**, columns 39 to 71, 92 to 99% carried, in a region of plasticity in 0.4 to 36% of calls; the model names 95 to 99% of genes. The window ends at columns 72 to 79, fork and variable, in a region of plasticity in 15 to 25% of calls, with a second branch of 4 families, 18 to 21% carried, [[galactonate catabolism]]. It ends at column 79, `rhtB`, in 44% of chromosomes.

label: yiiM
facts:
WINDOW: the yiiM window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yiiM, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 4,220 to 4,299 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yiiM once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 94% of genes, 0.22 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 31,959 calls, named 97%, 0.11 bits; shell 11,129 calls, named 86%, 0.51 bits; cloud 112 calls, named 16%, 2.07 bits. Outside an RGP 33,015 calls, named 96%, 0.13 bits; inside an RGP 10,185 calls, named 87%, 0.50 bits. Columns: 53 spine, 17 fork, 10 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.50 against 0.13 bits) and names fewer genes (87% against 96%); 10,185 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 10 (frvA) 0.75 bits, RGP 79%; column 1 (kdgT) 0.66 bits, RGP 0%; column 35 (ompL) 0.59 bits, RGP 77%. The 18 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 89%, 0.43 bits on average; the other 62 columns: named 95%, 0.16 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 26-38 (fork and variable columns), RGP 55-89%; the least: columns 0-9 (spine), RGP 0-9%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-9 (10 columns) spine: share 92-100%, all P, RGP 0-9%. Genes: yiiM "3-alpha domain-containing protein", kdgT, sodA, rhaT "L-rhamnose/proton symporter RhaT", rhaR, rhaS, rhaB, rhaA, rhaD, rhaM. named 11-100% (mean 89%), fewest named at column 4 (rhaR), named 11%; most hesitant at column 1 (kdgT), 0.66 bits.
2. columns 10-14 (5 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 70-80%. named 81-98% (mean 92%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 10, named 81%, 0.75 bits.
   10 fork: frvA S 78% "PTS sugar transporter subunit IIA"; also "carbohydrate porin" S 48%, "IS1-like element transposase" S 24%
   11 variable: frvB S 79%
   12 variable: frvX S 79%
   13 variable: frvR S 75%
   14 variable: yiiG S 69% "DUF3829 domain-containing protein"
3. columns 15-19 (5 columns) spine: share 98%, all P, RGP 3-27%. Genes: fdhD, fdnG, fdoH, fdoI "formate dehydrogenase cytochrome b5…", fdhE. named 93-99% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 15 (fdhD), named 93%, 0.34 bits.
4. column 20 fork: RGP 8%. named 95%; 0.21 bits.
   20: yiiF S 83%; also "alpha/beta hydrolase" S 21%
5. columns 21-25 (5 columns) spine: share 97-98%, all P, RGP 10-31%. Genes: yiiE "CopG family transcriptional regulat…", fabY, dtd, yihY "YihY family inner membrane protein", yihX "glucose-1-phosphatase". named 90-95% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 23 (dtd), named 90%, 0.48 bits.
6. columns 26-38 (13 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 55-89%. named 82-96% (mean 88%), fewest named at column 33, named 82%; most hesitant at column 35, 0.59 bits.
   a second branch of 8 families through columns 26-33, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 16-18%, all S; the branch's families: "aldose 1-epimerase", "MFS transporter", "MFS transporter", "alcohol dehydrogenase catalytic domain-…", "aldolase", yihU, "sugar kinase", "DeoR/GlpR family DNA-binding transcript…"
   26 fork: csqR S 77%
   27 fork: yihV S 76% "PfkB family carbohydrate kinase"
   28 fork: yihU S 75% "NAD-binding protein"
   29 fork: yihT S 76% "sulfofructosephosphate aldolase"
   30 fork: yihS S 75%
   31 fork: yihR S 71% "aldose-1-epimerase"
   32 fork: yihQ S 66% "sulfoquinovosidase"; also "TSUP family transporter" S 32%
   33 fork: yihP S 68% "MFS transporter"
   columns 34-38 variable, share 67-87%, all S: yihO "glycoside-pentoside-hexuronide (GPH…" 67%, ompL 68%, yihN "MFS transporter" 74%, yihM "sugar phosphate isomerase/epimerase…" 77%, yihL "GntR family transcriptional regulat…" 87%
7. columns 39-71 (33 columns) spine: share 92-99%, all P, RGP 0.4-36%. Genes: typA, glnA, glnL, glnG "nitrogen regulation protein NR(I)", yshB "YshB family small membrane protein", hemN, yihI "Der GTPase-activating protein YihI", yihA "ribosome biogenesis GTP-binding pro…", polA, yihG "acetyltransferase", yihF "DUF945 family protein", dsbA, srkA, yihD "YihD family protein", mobA "molybdenum cofactor guanylyltransfe…", mobB, hemG, trkH, yigZ "YigZ family protein", pepQ, fadB, fadA "acetyl-CoA C-acyltransferase", fre, ubiD, rfaH, tatD, tatC, tatB "Sec-independent protein translocase…", tatA, ubiB "ubiquinone biosynthesis regulatory…", ubiJ, ubiE, rmuC. named 95-99% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 48 (yihG), named 95%; most hesitant at column 49 (yihF), 0.26 bits.
8. columns 72-79 (8 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 15-25%. named 88-96% (mean 93%), fewest named at column 79, named 88%; most hesitant at column 78, 0.22 bits.
   a second branch of 4 families through columns 74-77, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 18-21%, all S; the branch's families: "2-dehydro-3-deoxygalactonokinase", "2-dehydro-3-deoxy-6-phosphogalactonate…", "Bug family tripartite tricarboxylate tr…", "tripartite tricarboxylate transporter T…"
   72 variable: udp P 89%
   73 fork: ysgA P 84%; also "tripartite tricarboxylate transporter p…" S 15%
   74 fork: metE P 67%
   75 fork: metR P 66% "HTH-type transcriptional regulator…"
   76 fork: bioP P 64%; also "cysteine hydrolase family protein" S 13%
   77 fork: yigL P 59% "HAD-IIB family hydrolase"; also "DUF2877 domain-containing protein" S 12%
   78 fork: pldB P 54%; also fdrA S 11%
   79 fork: rhtB P 44%; also rhtC P 31%, recQ P 23%, pldA P 17%
